summary: On Pixel 7, the connected voice room and persistent dock both displayed a 10 ms RTT while Push-to-talk kept the microphone muted; leaving disconnected the app and the original Voice Activity setting was restored.

checks.name: Pixel 7 real voice RTT and mute state
checks.command: Temporarily set Push-to-talk; enter SHARE_TEST; inspect only connection, ping and mic labels; leave voice
checks.observation: Both the voice-room badge and persistent dock exposed 10 ms RTT while connected. The dock accessibility state was 'Включить микрофон', confirming the microphone was muted; no screen share or message action occurred. The user authorized transfer of the existing voice lease before the test.

checks.name: Cleanup and restore user audio preference
checks.command: Leave voice; verify voice dock is absent; restore Voice Activity in Audio Settings
checks.observation: Voice dock disappeared and the app remained foreground. The previously selected Voice Activity mode was restored and verified.

remaining: Verify ping/quality updates on macOS, Windows and web, and repeat with a separate account/peer to validate multi-peer behavior.
